content: Manual reference outlines of 120 DYB-PlanktonNet test images (first pass).
dataset: DYB-PlanktonNet (IEEE DataPort, doi:10.21227/875n-f104, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0); images are not redistributed. dyb_folder/dyb_filename locate each image in the original dataset (see data/splits/test_files.csv).
coordinate_convention: continuous image-pixel coordinates; pixel (i,j) spans [i,i+1)x[j,j+1); origin top-left
protocol: Whole visible silhouette including antennae and appendages (setae thinner than one pixel excluded); one polygon per organism; no holes for internal or transparent regions; short faint stretches closed along the visible curvature; annotator blind to all pipeline masks.
